articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Beyond crypto funding rates: Ethena diversifies USDe backing with $1 billion FalconX facility
articles.description: The warehouse facility gives Ethena another source of returns for the assets backing USDe while channeling onchain capital into overcollateralized institutional loans.

articles.title: Strengthen the Clarity Act
articles.description: The American Bankers Association seeks to strengthen the Clarity Act, not kill it, argues Rob Nichols, president and CEO of the ABA.

articles.title: Bitcoin is flashing 8 of 12 capitulation signals, but bottom's not yet in, says VanEck
articles.description: Similar setups have historically produced below-average 90-day and 180-day bitcoin returns, said the asset manager.

articles.title: A year after losing $1.46 billion, Bybit says AI helped it save $700 million
articles.description: The exchange that lost $1.46 billion to North Korean hackers is the first large centralized firm to put numbers on a claim bitcoin developers have been making all month.

articles.title: Centrifuge adds Symbiotic liquidity network across $1.6B in Janus Henderson, NYLIM funds
articles.description: Symbiotic’s Liquid Lane gives eligible holders immediate USDC liquidity across three Centrifuge funds managed by Janus Henderson and NYLIM.

articles.title: Sweden’s H100 reports $26M H1 loss driven by falling Bitcoin value
articles.description: Sweden’s H100 reported a $26 million loss for the first half of the year, as it completed its acquisitions to become Europe’s second-largest Bitcoin treasury by holdings.

articles.title: China triples its e-CNY network in 2026 as 8 more banks join the CBDC push this week
articles.description: The People’s Bank of China (PBOC) added 20 new operators this year across two rounds of expansions, including eight additions this week.

articles.title: Alleged $165M Crypto Ponzi Mastermind Deported From Fiji to US
articles.description: Edward Zimbardi allegedly lured thousands of investors into "The Crypto Program" with promises of 25% monthly returns before fleeing to Fiji.

articles.title: Ripple raises $275M for US prime brokerage to meet institutional demand
articles.description: Ripple said the $275 million raised will support its expansion into traditional financial services such as prime brokerage and multi-asset clearing, citing strong demand from institutions.

articles.title: Fed decision making comes into focus as bitcoin holds steady, bond yields surge
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Aug. 19, 2026

articles.title: Bitcoin has ‘largely purged’ froth that preceded 50% drop from $126K: BlackRock
articles.description: Bitcoin maintained its appeal as a diversification investment despite dropping more than 50% from all-time high, a BlackRock report stated.

articles.title: Bitcoin stuck in a six-week range as global bond yields hit highest levels for decades
articles.description: BTC volatility has dropped to multi-year lows as surging Treasury yields rattle equities and traders await the Fed's July meeting minutes for clues on the interest-rate path.

articles.title: Nexo launches regulated crypto-backed credit in Australia
articles.description: Nexo introduced regulated, cryptocurrency-backed credit lines that allow users to access liquidity in Australian dollars or stablecoins by borrowing against their digital assets.

articles.title: TikTok code includes peer-to-peer payments over messaging: Bloomberg
articles.description: The feature, which follows earlier moves into financial transactions, is not yet being tested anywhere, a spokesperson said.

articles.title: Ripple raises $275 million in senior notes for prime brokerage push
articles.description: Ripple Prime's inaugural senior notes carried an investment grade rating and drew institutional investors across key financial markets.

articles.title: Winklevoss-Backed Cypherpunk Launches 'World's Largest' Zcash Mining Fleet
articles.description: The Nasdaq-listed privacy firm launched Cypherpunk Mining through a $33.33 million equity deal with Winklevoss Capital, adding roughly 18% of the Zcash network's hashrate to accelerate its treasury ambitions.

articles.title: OpenAI trails Anthropic as losses deepen and Altman pauses frontier AI training
articles.description: Widening losses and intensifying competition coincide with a pause in frontier reinforcement-learning training as openai strengthens its safety controls.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin takes aim at $65,000 as Treasury move sends yields lower
articles.description: Led by Scott Bessent, the U.S. Treasury announced at least a doubling in the size of its long-dated bond buybacks.

articles.title: Arthur Hayes takes CEO role at Flop Labs ahead of Q4 airdrop
articles.description: Hayes revealed his new role as Flop Labs CEO and teased a “massive airdrop” from the AI inference protocol in the fourth quarter of 2026.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs add $189M as August net inflows approach $1B
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs took in $189 million on Tuesday, lifting August net inflows to $951 million, while Ether ETFs added $71.5 million.

articles.title: Maya Protocol exploit drains bitcoin and other assets as pool value drops by $11 million
articles.description: A chain of six flaws caused the cross-chain trading network to credit a pool with nearly 50 million tokens that were never properly funded, letting an attacker drain real assets.

articles.title: Robot maker Unitree’s IPO surges 600% , outpacing crypto traders’ premarket bets
articles.description: A Hyperliquid perp priced Unitree far above its IPO valuation before Shanghai trading began, but the robot maker’s first public trade still opened roughly 75% above crypto traders’ implied price.

articles.title: MAYAChain halts network after estimated $1.7M exploit
articles.description: A preliminary analysis says six chained bugs let a 23-message transaction drain 48.87 million CACAO, sending the token down nearly 89%.

articles.title: Bitcoin holds $64,000 and solana leads gains amid 7% Korean chip stock slide
articles.description: Bitcoin held near $64,000 and every major except BNB gained, while Korean semiconductor stocks fell more than 7% and Fed minutes are due at 2 p.m. ET.

articles.title: US accounting board FASB proposes conditions for stablecoins as cash equivalents
articles.description: The FASB said secondary-market liquidity alone would not be enough, with holders needing direct issuer redemption rights and one-to-one liquid reserves.

articles.title: ‘It has to pass’: Andrew Cuomo warns U.S. is falling behind on crypto rules

articles.title: Robinhood CEO urges U.S. to clear path for tokenized stocks as overseas markets advance

articles.title: Pennsylvania Cracks Down on AI Data Centers as Backlash Grows
articles.description: Gov. Josh Shapiro ordered new restrictions on large data centers aimed at shielding residents from higher electricity costs and giving communities more control over proposed projects.

articles.title: Mozilla Tests an AI 'Smart Window' in Firefox—But Only If You Opt In

articles.title: Rare Books Traced to Amazon AI Training Facility to Be Scanned and Destroyed

articles.title: U.S. accounting-standards group proposes way to see stablecoins as 'cash equivalent'

articles.title: SEC proposes new crypto rules in absence of CLARITY Act

articles.title: Arguing With People on X May Get You More Posts You Hate as Algo Feeds on Ragebait

articles.title: Cypherpunk launches Zcash mining fleet controlling 18% of network hashrate

articles.title: Markets Confident OpenAI Releases Its Next AI Model in Weeks

articles.title: Wyoming joins $15 billion LayerZero exodus with state stablecoin move

articles.title: Bitcoin has gone quiet as traders chase ‘5x or 10x’ payoffs elsewhere
